company.name: AutoStream
company.description: AutoStream is a SaaS product that provides automated video editing tools for content creators. Powered by AI, it helps YouTubers, Instagrammers, and other digital creators produce polished, professional videos in minutes.

policies.detail: No refunds are provided after 7 days of purchase. Refunds can be requested within the first 7 days.
24/7 support is available exclusively for Pro plan subscribers. Basic plan subscribers have access to email support during business hours.
You can cancel your subscription at any time. Your access continues until the end of the billing cycle.

faq.question: What platforms does AutoStream support?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports exports optimized for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn.

faq.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upgrade from Basic to Pro at any time. You will be charged the prorated difference for the remaining billing period.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: AutoStream offers a 7-day free trial on the Pro plan. No credit card required to start.
